answer_2.quote: We leverage LLMs as the automatic semantic evaluation agent. ... compute a semantic F1-score.

answer_3.quote: We will use GPT-4o as the automatic evaluation agent in the subsequent evaluation experiments.

answer_4.quote: We invite 3 professional event annotators to evaluate 200 event-containing documents (791 prediction-gold event pairs in total). These annotators are given the same prompts as those given to LLMs.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were provided with the same prompts used for LLM evaluation to judge semantic correspondence of predictions and gold annotations.
